title: Law to reform how citizen idling complaints are handled
summary: This bill would change the city's citizen air complaint program used to enforce engine idling rules, including new cure options letting violators avoid penalties by certifying installation of anti-idling technology, revised timelines for complaint review and adjudication, lower reward percentages for complainants (reduced from 25% to 12.5% and from 50% to 25%), and a new code of conduct for people filing complaints. It also updates definitions like bus, truck and school bus depot and extends the complaint response window from 45 to 90 days.
